results.note: The test asserts that the catalog-v2 call is request #1. It then checks that the history start_time equals the later of the two per-metric min_times (FlowOut 2020-02-01) and that both min_times appear in source_field. The implementation is _catalog_metric_min_times plus backfill_coinmetrics_asset_metrics in ingest/fetchers/coinmetrics.py.

An empty response for a start_time equal to the catalog min_time returns (). The test at line 233 shows that a start_time before min_time raises ValueError, and no history request is made. So an empty result is only accepted after the catalog check has placed the query inside the entitlement window. The line-233 test calls the private _history_rows directly.

The test makes 12 requests (1 catalog and 11 paginated pages) on a fake clock. It asserts that every run of 10 consecutive requests spans at least 6s, which is enforced by CoinMetricsRateLimiter at 0.7s spacing. No 429 retry path is tested.

The test asserts that the second request URL exactly equals the vendor's next_page_url. In _history_rows, params is set to None after the first page, so later requests are sent unmodified. Rows from both pages come back in order ([1.0, 2.0] with matching timestamps), and paging stops once next_page_url is absent.

In attempt 3 the @pytest.mark.integration marker was removed: a grep finds no pytest.mark or pytestmark in the file, and conftest.py has no skip hooks. That means `uv run pytest -q` now collects this test. It drives the public run_backfill entry point (ingest/backfill.py:67) against live Coin Metrics, using the registry, the real recipe (wrapped only to persist the earliest run) and persist_board, into a real Postgres schema. It asserts that the persisted source_timestamp equals the live catalog-v2 min_time and that origin is 'backfill'. The fixture raises rather than skips when no database is reachable, and live HTTP failures also raise. So the C6 gate's exit 0 at HEAD is indirect proof that this test ran and passed. Caveat: the committed gates.json is stale from attempt 2 (it shows 74 deselected), so the test count at HEAD cannot be confirmed from a file.

The US-905-C6 gate `uv run pytest -q` exited 0, and typecheck (mypy --strict) exited 0. Note: the "offline" suite now contains one live network and database test, because attempt 3 removed that test's integration marker.

note: The offline tests for C1–C4 make real assertions against MockTransport and are not faked.
